programs.title: Master of Business Analytics
programs.description: In the business world, understanding and interpreting data is an integral part of decision making. The Master of Business Analytics has been developed in consultation with industry and gives you in-demand skills to help organisations achieve their strategic objectives through analytics-based solutions.
eligibility: TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent English language proficiency

programs.title: Master of Cyber Security (Professional)
programs.description: Professionals with cyber security skills are crucial for the ongoing success of our digital future and are in high demand globally. The Master of Cyber Security (Professional) equips you with sought-after skills to tackle cyber security challenges from both a technical and organisational perspective.
eligibility: Early-career graduates in computer science or related disciplines
TOEFL/IELTS or equivalent English language proficiency

whyDeakinGiftCity.title: Globally Recognised Deakin Degree in India
whyDeakinGiftCity.description: Graduate with the same Deakin University qualification and academic standards as Australia while studying closer to home. TEQSA accreditation ensures quality.

whyDeakinGiftCity.title: Strategic Location in GIFT City
whyDeakinGiftCity.description: Study in India's global financial and innovation hub with practical exposure to the industries shaping the future of business and technology.

whyDeakinGiftCity.title: Career Outcomes Built Into Every Course
whyDeakinGiftCity.description: Combine industry projects, internships and placement support designed to help you graduate job ready with hands-on experience.

whyDeakinGiftCity.title: International Learning Experience
whyDeakinGiftCity.description: Benefit from a global curriculum, academic leaders in their field, visiting international academics and immersion programs at Deakin's Australia campuses.
